snippet.title: PAC-MAN Mega Tunnel Battle: Chomp Champs – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
PAC-MAN Mega Tunnel Battle: Chomp Champs is available now on Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6051YVyoH 
 
Competitive Eating meets battle royale in PAC-MAN Mega Tunnel Battle: Chomp Champs! Eat your way through an arena of mazes while chomping GHOSTS and PACs in this clash of the appetites to be the Last PAC Standing of 64 players! Climb the leaderboards in style with an array of cosmetic accessories and use Power Items to turn the tables on your foes! Competition never tasted this good! 
 
#PACMAN #NintendoSwitch
